with.title: Claude Code runs remotely on Bedrock AgentCore

possibilities.connection: Claude Code on Bedrock AgentCore runs isolated remote sessions with no cost figures, and TokenEconomizer learns from repository sessions to cut cost, so a fleet working the same repositories feeds the plugin more sessions to learn from.

possibilities.title: Coding agent cost cuts stack only if tool pruning keeps cached prefixes stable

with.title: Together explains cache protection for agents

possibilities.connection: TokenEconomizer saves money by injecting facts and dropping tools, while Together warns that long sessions depend on stable prompt prefixes, so naive pruning can quietly break the cache.

appearances.newly_possible: Teams can use an open-source plugin that learns from repository sessions to inject short facts, drop unused tools and stop failing loops.
appearances.why: Across 277 tasks, mean cost fell 18.4% to 30.9%, with Pass@1 improving in four of five agent-model settings.
appearances.limits: Reported savings may not transfer to your repositories
